profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Adobe Analytics
profile.summary: Data science engineer and full stack software developer that thrives off of finding elegant solutions to complex problems. I enjoy learning new technologies and methods for creating powerful tools. I have strong interpersonal skills and prefer working in collaborative environments.

positions.description: Skills: React.js · TypeScript

positions.description: Skills: React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Sr Data Science Engineer
positions.description: Develop powerful and intuitive solutions that help our engineers solve complex problems

positions.title: Process Owner
positions.description:
Statistical process control (SPC) and fault detection (FD) specialist for the Wet Process division.
Wet Bench and Copper Plating Process Owner.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research CFD implementation techniques for turbomachinery with inlet distortion. 
Maintain knowledge of research field by reading relevant technical journals. 
Contribute to field by publishing research accomplishments in turbomachinery technical journals.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
TA for ME 426 Gas Turbine and Jet Engine Design. 
Maintain a mastery of class concepts. 
Help students learn how to approach thermodynamic and compressible flow problems.

positions.title: Head of Product Development
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of engineers at BYU and NASA Marshall Space Flight Center to design, test and optimize an interstage and separation mechanism for the NASA Nanolaunch project.
Final design met all design requirements and reduced system cost by 95% and system weight by 50% from the previous design.

positions.title: Head of Manufacturing
positions.description:
Led and managed a team of engineering interns.
Ensured project milestones and deadlines were met.
Investigated and implemented more efficient manufacturing methods.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description:
Served as church representative and volunteer in the Sendai, Japan area
Trained two other representatives in both procedures and language skills
Led a group of 12 representatives as division leader

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
